name: pack_tensor
description: Transform tensor layout to a cache-friendly blocked format using tensor.pack operation, materializing a temporary contiguous buffer for improved memory access patterns.

parameters.name: tensor_name
parameters.description: The name/index of the tensor operand to pack (e.g., 'arg0' for first argument)

parameters.name: pack_tile_shape
parameters.description: Target pack tile shape as list of integers. Length must match tensor rank. Zero dimensions are skipped. Example: [64, 128] for 2D, [8, 32, 32] for 3D.

parameters.name: outer_dims_perm
parameters.description: Optional permutation of outer dimensions before packing (for layout restructuring). None means no permutation.
